evidence.title: Slim icons — Free and open source icon library

name: Slim Icons
summary: Free open-source icon library of 200 slim-style icons, shipped as React components from npm with stroke width and color props.
description: Icon library of 200 icons drawn in a slim stroke style, published on npm as React components. Icons take size and color props; the site previews the set with adjustable stroke width and color. MIT licensed, maintained on GitHub where contributions and icon requests are collected.
contains: 200 icons in a slim stroke style
size and color props on each icon
stroke width and color adjustable on the site
MIT licensed, contributions and icon requests via GitHub
